q: How many pumps of syrup? cappuccino

chunks.text: Flavored drinks (vanilla, caramel, or hazelnut) get 2 pumps in Small, 3 pumps in Medium, and 4 pumps in Large.
chunks.heading: Flavor syrup amounts
chunks.title: Drink Recipes

chunks.text: One pump of flavor syrup is 1/4 fl oz (7.5 mL). One pump of mocha sauce is 1/2 fl oz (15 mL).
chunks.heading: Pump sizes
chunks.title: Drink Recipes

chunks.text: If flavored, pump the syrup into the empty cup.
chunks.heading: Latte: add syrup
chunks.title: Drink Recipes

chunks.text:
| | Small | Medium | Large |
|---|---|---|---|
| Espresso shots | 2 | 2 | 3 |
| Steamed milk | 8 oz | 12 oz | 14 oz |

Foam is about 1/4 inch of microfoam. If a flavor is ordered, add syrup using the pump amounts in section 1.3.
chunks.heading: Latte specifications
chunks.title: Drink Recipes

chunks.text:
| | Small | Medium | Large |
|---|---|---|---|
| Espresso shots | 2 | 2 | 3 |
| Mocha sauce | 2 pumps | 3 pumps | 4 pumps |
| Steamed milk | 8 oz | 10 oz | 12 oz |

Whipped cream is optional and free.
chunks.heading: Mocha specifications
chunks.title: Drink Recipes

chunks.text: Pump syrup into the cold cup if flavored, then pour in the cold milk.
chunks.heading: Iced latte: add syrup and milk
